items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: I worked with Emil Williams like that, playing guitar and vocal.

ctx.x: Jay and you were his guitar player and vocalist. Wolf's Tavern, right downtown.
18th and Vine Streets and we played there for a while and I did quite a bit of work like that. I worked with Emil Williams like that, playing guitar and vocal.

Well, I never knew Emil but Jis a dear friend of mine and just a beautiful guy and it seems to me the numbers that he's written and the music he's played, that's Kansas City Jazz. He's not the only one to personify it but surely he's one of the leading exponents of it, whereas I can never consider Charlie Parker a leading exponent of
